discrepancies.finding: assert_ownership() granted bypass if user_id was empty, 'anonymous', or 'default_user'.
discrepancies.remediation: Removed all bypass branches. Enforced mandatory authenticated user_id and tenant_id with fail-closed security audit events.

discrepancies.finding: Workers lacked monotonically increasing fencing tokens, allowing stale workers to commit assets after lease expiry.
discrepancies.remediation: Introduced lease_generation fencing tokens validated on every heartbeat, state transition, and artifact publication.

discrepancies.finding: Multi-process claim races were not verified under true OS process concurrency.
discrepancies.remediation: Executed independent multi-process claim benchmark across 4 separate OS processes; proven collision-safe via POSIX rename.

discrepancies.finding: Immediate XDEL after XACK violated PEL audit retention and stream durability.
discrepancies.remediation: Prohibited immediate XDEL; defined sliding-window MAXLEN ~ 50000 retention and safe PEL dead-letter handling.

discrepancies.finding: Idempotency keys were not tenant-scoped and did not include garment category, subcategory, or reconstruction parameters.
discrepancies.remediation: Implemented compute_canonical_fingerprint() and IdempotencyRegistry raising 409 Conflict on payload mismatch.

discrepancies.finding: Labeled as 2PC without true distributed two-phase commit semantics.
discrepancies.remediation: Renamed to Atomic Artifact Publication Protocol with 12-step validation, glTF JSON chunk parse, and startup reconciliation.

discrepancies.finding: Retrying failed jobs erased historical attempt error logs.
discrepancies.remediation: Introduced append-only 'attempts' list preserving error codes, timestamps, and worker IDs across retries.

discrepancies.finding: Hardcoded 4-worker concurrency assumption on NVIDIA L4 without memory measurement.
discrepancies.remediation: Implemented calculate_cuda_concurrency_limit() deriving safe worker count from measured model resident and peak activation VRAM.

discrepancies.finding: Base production total cost ($727.87) was mathematically smaller than GPU subtotal ($745.92).
discrepancies.remediation: Recalculated line items: $745.92 GPU compute + $56.28 auxiliary infrastructure = $802.20/mo total.
